none: PAS CAM-5F50C0: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLO[RIA] EXERCITVS ; D/ CONS[...]IVN NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLO[RIA] EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint is unknown. Obverse shows Laureate, cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONS[...]IVN NOB C. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.05g, diameter is 18.5mm
